line: Crowley on Wands: Fire and Aries, the flames of the Ace of Wands as Yods, and the letter of Fire (pdf p23, p24, p35, p175, p183).

sections.title: Fire and Aries
sections.line: Crowley's attribution of Wands to Fire (pdf p24) and to Aries (pdf p35).

quotes.quote: “Wands”, attributed to Fire; “Cups”, to Water; “Swords”, to Air;
Wands has the attribution of Aries, and represents swift violence of onset, the lightning flash.

sections.title: The flames of the Ace
sections.line: Crowley's description of the Ace of Wands: the flames as Yods and the solarphallic outburst of flame (pdf p183).

quotes.quote: These flames are Yods, arranged in the form of the Tree of Life.
It is a solarphallic outburst of flame from which spring lightnings in every direction.

sections.title: The letter of Fire
sections.line: Crowley on the letters Shin, Mem and Aleph for the elements (pdf p23) and on Shin as the letter of Fire (pdf p175).

quotes.quote: These elements are represented in the Hebrew alphabet by the letters Shin, Mem and Aleph.
The letter Shin, which is the letter of Fire, has to do double duty by representing Spirit as well.
